info.title: OpenGWAS Data API
info.description:
Query OpenGWASDB Store Releases with OpenGWAS's operations: analysis metadata, associations,
top hits, PheWAS and variant lookups.

**Every data query is a job.** `POST` a query to its operation's path (or to `/api/jobs` with
an `endpoint`). The answer is `202` with a `job_id` and `poll_after_seconds`. Poll
`GET /api/jobs/{job_id}` until `status` is `succeeded`, then read `GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/result`
page by page, following `next_cursor` until `final` is true. Each page holds up to 1,000 rows as
newline-delimited JSON (`ndjson`). Resubmitting the same query returns the same job.

**Authentication.** Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Through the Gateway, the token is your
OpenGWAS token and paths start with the Gateway's `/ogdb` prefix. Developers calling the Data API
directly use a developer key.

**LD.** `GET /api/ld/stores` lists the LD Stores served, one per ancestry. `/api/ld/matrix`,
`/api/ld/region`, `/api/ld/clump`, `/api/ld/proxies` and `/api/ld/reflookup` run as jobs, on one
store each, named by `store` or `ancestry`.

**Not yet implemented.** Allele-frequency lookups
(`/api/variants/afl2*`), gene lookups (`/api/variants/gene/*`), and the `edit` and
`quality_control` families answer `501` with the text `Not yet implemented`. They are not listed
here.

The code samples read `OGDB_URL` (for example `http://localhost:6432`, or the Gateway's URL
ending in `/ogdb`) and `OGDB_TOKEN` from the environment.

post.description: As `GET /api/gwasinfo`, with the selection in the body: `releases` for chosen Stores, or `release_set`. With `id` (up to 1,000 analysis IDs, bare or Store-qualified), returns those analyses' metadata in the order given, instead of a page. A bare ID held by several Stores returns each Store's row. IDs no served Store holds are listed in `not_found`, and those of retired Stores in `retired`. An OpenGWAS ID (`ukb-b-19953`, `ebi-a-GCST000998`, `eqtl-a-ENSG…`, `finn-b-CODE`) returns the analyses that hold that study, and `opengwas` gives, for each, the catalog ids it resolved to and the match (`exact`, or `successor` for FinnGen, whose release differs), or why there is none. `GET` takes `id` too, repeated.

get.description: Analyses whose label contains `q`, ignoring case, for example every study of body mass index. The text is literal (no wildcards). Narrow with `store_id`, `assigned_ancestry`, `ancestry_category`, `outcome_type` or `trait_class`, each exact. Rows are those of `/api/gwasinfo`, ordered by label; `total` counts every match. Page with `after`, set to the previous page's `next_after`. Answers at once: it is not a job. With `match=fulltext`, `q` is a boolean query over label, trait, consortium, first author and IDs: `AND`, `OR`, `NOT`, parentheses, `"phrases"`, `prefix*` and `column:term` (for example `first_author:locke`). It matches whole words (`bmi*` for BMI1 too), ranks the best match first, pages by `offset` (`next_offset`, up to 10,000), and answers a malformed query with `400 invalid_query`. Put an ID with hyphens in double quotes.

post.summary: Submit any query as a job

202.description: Job accepted, or the user's existing job for this query

post.description: Submit a query with its operation in `endpoint` (default `/api/associations`) and that operation's fields. The same as posting the fields to the operation's own path: both make the same job.

x-codeSamples.label: R (httr2)
x-codeSamples.source:
library(httr2)

base <- Sys.getenv("OGDB_URL", "http://localhost:6432")
api <- function(path) {
  request(paste0(base, path)) |> req_auth_bearer_token(Sys.getenv("OGDB_TOKEN"))
}

# Submit the query: the answer is 202 with a job_id.
job <- api("/api/jobs") |>
  req_body_json(list(endpoint = "/api/associations", variants = list("rs234"), analyses = list("GCST000998"))) |>
  req_perform() |> resp_body_json()

# Poll until the job finishes.
repeat {
  status <- api(paste0("/api/jobs/", job$job_id)) |> req_perform() |> resp_body_json()
  if (!status$status %in% c("queued", "running")) break
  Sys.sleep(status$poll_after_seconds)
}
if (status$status != "succeeded") stop(status$error)

# Read every page of the result.
pages <- list()
cursor <- NULL
repeat {
  req <- api(paste0("/api/jobs/", job$job_id, "/result"))
  if (!is.null(cursor)) req <- req_url_query(req, cursor = cursor)
  page <- req |> req_perform() |> resp_body_json()
  pages[[length(pages) + 1]] <- jsonlite::stream_in(textConnection(page$ndjson), verbose = FALSE)
  if (isTRUE(page$final)) break
  cursor <- page$next_cursor
}
result <- jsonlite::rbind_pages(pages)

import json
import os
import time

import requests

base = os.environ.get("OGDB_URL", "http://localhost:6432")
session = requests.Session()
session.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {os.environ['OGDB_TOKEN']}"

# Submit the query: the answer is 202 with a job_id.
submitted = session.post(f"{base}/api/jobs", json={'endpoint': '/api/associations', 'variants': ['rs234'], 'analyses': ['GCST000998']})
submitted.raise_for_status()
job_id = submitted.json()["job_id"]

# Poll until the job finishes.
while True:
    status = session.get(f"{base}/api/jobs/{job_id}").json()
    if status["status"] not in ("queued", "running"):
        break
    time.sleep(status["poll_after_seconds"])
if status["status"] != "succeeded":
    raise RuntimeError(status["error"])

# Read every page of the result.
rows, params = [], {}
while True:
    page = session.get(f"{base}/api/jobs/{job_id}/result", params=params).json()
    rows += [json.loads(line) for line in page["ndjson"].splitlines()]
    if page["final"]:
        break
    params = {"cursor": page["next_cursor"]}

x-codeSamples.source:
# Submit the query: the answer is 202 with a job_id.
curl -s -X POST "$OGDB_URL/api/jobs" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OGDB_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"endpoint": "/api/associations", "variants": ["rs234"], "analyses": ["GCST000998"]}'

# Poll until "status" is "succeeded", waiting poll_after_seconds between polls.
curl -s "$OGDB_URL/api/jobs/$JOB_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OGDB_TOKEN"

# Read the first page; repeat with ?cursor=<next_cursor> until "final" is true.
curl -s "$OGDB_URL/api/jobs/$JOB_ID/result" -H "Authorization: Bearer $OGDB_TOKEN"

tags.description: Metadata about the analyses (GWAS and other studies) the Stores hold.

tags.name: associations
tags.description: Associations between variants and analyses: chosen variants in chosen analyses, every association of an analysis, or every association in a genomic range. Each runs as a job.

tags.name: tophits
tags.description: The strongest associations of analyses, from each Store's precomputed top-hit index, at or below a p-value threshold, optionally LD-clumped on the server. Runs as a job.

tags.name: phewas
tags.description: The associations of one variant across the analyses of the chosen Stores, at or below a p-value threshold. Runs as a job.

tags.name: variants
tags.description: Variants by rsID or by chromosome and position, from each Store's variant table. Runs as a job.

tags.name: ld
tags.description: Linkage disequilibrium from the LD Stores, one per ancestry: each pair's signed r, exact or refused, never approximated. A pair a store does not hold is null, never 0.

tags.name: jobs
tags.description: Submit any query as a job, poll it, read its result in pages, or cancel it. The other groups' data paths submit jobs too.
